ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central and upper portions of both lobes. Low-intensity (dark) mottling and solid banding are concentrated along the trailing edge and around the median notch. A significant dark contiguous blob is localized on the far left lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 115 degrees and shallow depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a heavily serrated linear profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve trajectory from the notch to the lateral tips, with the right lobe showing a slightly steeper upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are detected within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep V-shaped indentation or missing tissue segment on the far left lateral edge and prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an exceptionally irregular and 'tattered' topography compared to standard fluke morphology.
